hooks.command:
p=$(cat); if [ -z "${HERDR_PANE_ID:-}" ] || ! command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"decision":"allow"}'; exit 0; fi; d=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolInput.description // "the delegated task"'); c=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.cwd // "."'); jq -n --arg d "$d" --arg c "$c" '{decision:"deny",reason:("In-process subagents are disabled under Herdr: they run inside this process with no terminal of their own, so a pane has nothing to display. Start a real agent instead, a full Grok TUI in its own pane, with the same task you were about to delegate (" + $d + "). Run this as ONE shell command, replacing NAME and TASK:

pane=$(herdr pane split --current --direction right --cwd "" + $c + "" --no-focus | jq -r .result.pane.pane_id)
sid=$(uuidgen)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do herdr agent start NAME --kind grok --pane $pane -- --session-id $sid "TASK" && break; sleep 1; done
herdr agent wait NAME --until working --timeout 30000 >/dev/null 2>&1
herdr agent wait NAME --until idle --until blocked --timeout 900000 | jq -r .result.agent.agent_status
herdr agent read NAME --source recent-unwrapped --lines 200

The details matter, all three were verified: pass TASK as the agent argument after --, never through agent prompt, because a freshly started TUI queues prompts while it shows Starting session; keep the retry loop, because the new pane needs a few seconds to reach its shell prompt; keep --cwd absolute, because a relative one resolves to / and the agent stops on a trust dialog. TASK must be self-contained: the new agent inherits none of this conversation.

The pane stays open and you own its lifetime. The agent is a full session with memory, so follow up with: herdr agent prompt NAME MORE-TEXT --wait --timeout 900000, then read again. Close it with: herdr pane close $pane && grok sessions delete $sid, as soon as you are done with that agent; the delete is what keeps these throwaway agents out of the session history, and account for every pane you opened before you end your turn. A blocked agent is waiting for input: leave its pane open and tell the user its name and pane id. NAME matches [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31} and must be unique among live agents. Split --direction down instead when the current pane is narrow. Do not create workspaces, tabs, or worktrees, and keep focus in this pane.")}'
